description: Flag new business rules in NestJS services that have zero corresponding test coverage.
State machine transitions should be tested for both valid and invalid paths.

Flag actual business-logic changes without updated or added tests: server-side invariants, permissions, state transitions, money or availability rules, API or worker behavior, data transformations, or contract semantics. SKIP purely presentational UI variants, class composition, visual-only branches, AND pure wrappers around a single external dependency where any unit test would only mock that dependency (these fail the value gate from `testing-conventions`). Load `testing-conventions` SKILL.md before flagging — apply its value gate first.
Flag new reusable UI component variants or presentational branches without focused tests when a regression would be user-visible. Do not use this rule for one-off markup or class-only changes.

Zod schema test that only validates built-in validators (`.min()`, `.max()`, `.default()`, `.email()`, `.uuid()`, `z.coerce` coercion, enum rejection) with no custom `.refine()`, `.transform()`, or `discriminatedUnion`. Those are the library's job, not yours. Exception: if a parameter controls the limit (e.g. `createSchema(maxPageSize)`) test that the parameter is correctly wired to `.max()` - that catches a real wiring bug.
Unit test where mock returns X and assertion checks X came back with no transformation or branching in between. Proves the mock works, not the code.
N near-identical tests varying only the field name when all fields go through the same code path. Collapse into one test with multiple assertions.
Mock setup exceeds 5x the assertion code. Replace with an integration/e2e test.
Tests that NestJS routes requests, React renders components, TanStack Query caches, or Drizzle returns rows. Those libraries have their own test suites.
No shared mutable state between tests - each test sets up and tears down its own data.
Tests must not depend on execution order.
Flag test files that import or mutate module-level variables shared across test cases.

Flag `vi.clearAllMocks()` in shared `resetMocks()` helpers that re-seeds only some infrastructure mock methods. Every method the production code can call - including teardown methods like `quit`/`disconnect` - must be re-seeded.
Flag `await app.close()` without prior `app.getHttpServer().closeAllConnections()`. On Node 18+, `close()` alone hangs on keep-alive sockets.
Flag `app.getHttpServer().keepAliveTimeout = 0` or `= 1`. Use Node defaults; drain via `closeAllConnections()`.

Flag specs that import `AppModule`/`RedisModule`/`BullModule` without `vi.mock('ioredis', ...)`, `vi.mock('@nest-lab/throttler-storage-redis', ...)`, and `vi.mock('@nestjs/bullmq', ...)` (last one only required if the module imports BullMQ).
Flag `expect(true).toBe(true)` or other tautological assertions.
Flag tests that assert on internal method call counts instead of observable results.
Flag tests where the assertion cannot possibly fail given the test setup.
Mock at boundaries (DB adapters, HTTP clients, queue producers), not internal service methods.
Flag mocks that replicate business logic instead of returning fixed responses.
